title: SLGO bottom HUD status payload (hud.status)
description: The viewer's own held-firearm ammo and this round's kills. One recipient per publish; sent only to clients declaring hud-status.

ammo.description: Held firearm; null when the held item is not a firearm or the player is dead.

clip_max.description: Clip capacity; a chambered round may exceed it.

reserve.description: Reserve rounds of this firearm (not magazines).

round_kills.description: One kind per kill this round, in order; reset when the buy phase starts.
